tip: Die Flinte ins Korn werfen is a set idiom for giving up, nothing to do with a real Flinte or Korn.
Alter as a form of address means dude or mate in casual speech, unrelated to age: Kannst du mir das leihen, Alter.
Vorausgesetzt means provided that and sets a condition; with dass left out, the clause keeps main clause order: das Budget wird genehmigt.
The particle halt marks something as simply the way it is, resigned acceptance: das Wetter ist halt grau.
In perfect passive the helper is worden, not geworden: ist bestätigt worden means has been confirmed.
After entweder you can keep normal order (entweder wir finden) or invert (entweder finden wir), then oder gives the alternative.
